title: Dashboard Load Performance
description: Verify that the dashboard loads in less than 3 seconds with updated and accurate data displayed in all widgets.

steps.description: Log in as a valid user with multiple transactions and categories.
Navigate to the Mission Control Dashboard.
Check that all dashboard widgets (balance, transactions, categories, savings goals, credit card debt) are displayed.
Measure load time and confirm it is below 3 seconds.
Verify that data values correspond to user's latest transactions and balances.

title: Create Transaction with Multi-Currency Conversion
description: Test creating a financial transaction in one currency and verify automatic correct conversion and balance update in base currency.

steps.description: Navigate to the create transaction form.
Input valid transaction data with amount in USD currency.
Select a category and payment method.
Submit the transaction form.
Verify transaction is recorded with correct converted amount in ARS (base currency).
Verify user balance is updated accordingly with multi-currency conversion applied.

title: Transaction Creation Validates Positive Amount
description: Ensure transaction cannot be created with zero or negative amount values.

steps.description: Navigate to the new transaction form.
Input transaction with amount = 0.
Attempt to submit the transaction.
Check an error message is displayed preventing submission.
Repeat the test with a negative amount.
Verify transaction creation is blocked with appropriate error.

title: Manage Categories: Create, Edit, Disable, Delete
description: Verify full CRUD on categories including uniqueness by user, color/icon customization, and impact on associated transactions.

steps.description: Create a new category with unique name, color, and icon.
Confirm category appears in list and is selectable in transaction forms.
Attempt to create another category with the same name for the same user.
Verify error is returned for duplicate category name.
Edit existing category's name and visual properties.
Verify edits are persisted and reflected in associated transactions.
Disable a category.
Check category becomes unavailable for new transactions but existing transactions retain category.
Delete a category not associated with any transactions.
Confirm category is removed from user category list.

title: Manage Payment Methods Uniqueness and Usage Stats
description: Test CRUD operations on payment methods ensuring uniqueness per user and correctness of usage statistics.

steps.description: Create a new payment method (e.g., debit card) with unique name.
Verify method appears in list and in transaction forms.
Attempt creating duplicate payment method name.
Assert creation fails with appropriate error.
Review payment method usage statistics widget.
Ensure stats reflect accurate counts of transactions associated with each payment method.

title: Savings Goals: Creation, Tracking Progress, and Completion
description: Verify creation of savings goals with visual progress bars, automatic transaction association, state changes on completion.

steps.description: Create a new savings goal with a target amount.
Confirm goal appears in the objectives widget with zero progress initially.
Create a transaction associated to this savings goal.
Verify progress bar reflects updated amount towards the goal.
Add transactions until goal target is reached or exceeded.
Check that goal status updates to complete and visual indicators reflect completion.

title: Credit Card Summary Payment and Transaction Creation
description: Test paying credit card summaries results in creation of corresponding transactions and updates related summaries and payment statuses.

steps.description: Navigate to credit card summaries section.
Select a summary with outstanding balance.
Confirm payment.
Verify a payment transaction is created and linked to credit card.
Check the summary status is updated to paid and next payment date is set.

title: Pending Payments Management with Filters
description: Verify creation, editing, filtering, and display of pending payments including filtering by overdue and upcoming statuses.

steps.description: Create multiple pending payments with various due dates and priorities.
Confirm pending payments appear correctly with expected details.
Apply filter to show only overdue payments.
Validate only overdue payments are visible.
Apply filter to show payments due soon.
Ensure payments with upcoming due dates are displayed correctly.
Edit a pending payment's due date and priority.
Verify changes are saved and reflected in UI and filters.

title: Conversational Financial AI Agent Responds and Executes Functions
description: Test the AI agent for natural language responses and correct function calls for querying balances, creating transactions, and analyses.

steps.description: Open the AI chatbot interface.
Ask for current balance summary.
Validate AI provides clear, accurate natural language response.
Request AI to create a new expense transaction.
Check AI executes function call and confirms creation.
Ask AI for spending analysis by category.
Verify AI returns meaningful analysis text and/or charts.

title: Bulk Upload Transactions CSV with Validation and Preview
description: Validate CSV upload flow: load file, show preview with validations per row, block corrupt rows, and confirm import.

steps.description: Navigate to bulk transaction upload page.
Upload a valid CSV file with multiple transactions.
Display preview table with transaction data and validation statuses.
Upload a CSV with some invalid rows (e.g., missing required fields, invalid amounts).
Highlight invalid rows with error messages, prevent import.
Correct invalid rows and confirm import.
Verify only valid rows are imported as transactions and balances update.

title: Multi-Tenancy Data Security Enforcement
description: Verify that users can only access and modify their own data, enforcing tenant isolation in all queries and operations.

steps.description: Log in as User A and access transactions, categories, payment methods.
Confirm only User A's data is visible.
Try to access User B's data via API direct calls or URL modification.
Verify access is denied with appropriate authorization errors.
Attempt to create or modify data referencing User B's tenant.
Ensure backend blocks the operation and logs security violation.

title: Budget Limits Per Category with Monthly and Annual Tracking
description: Test creation and tracking of budgets per category with enforcement of limits and proper tracking on all cycle types.

steps.description: Create a monthly budget limit for a spending category.
Confirm budget appears in budget widget with correct limit.
Add transactions in that category and monitor budget progress.
Verify progress updates accurately and alerts if limit is near or exceeded.
Create an annual budget and repeat similar testing.
Ensure annual cycle tracks correctly distinct from monthly limits.

title: Real-time Dollar and CEDEAR Quotation Accuracy
description: Verify that dollar quotations (official, blue, MEP, CCL) and CEDEAR prices update in real-time and graphs refresh accordingly.

steps.description: Open the dollar quotation widget.
Confirm all dollar price types are displayed with latest values.
Open CEDEARs market view.
Validate CEDEAR prices update accurately with charts rendering price history.

title: Responsive Navigation on Mobile Devices
description: Test bottom navigation and responsive menu on various mobile devices and screen sizes for correct accessibility and usability.

steps.description: Access the application from different mobile device emulators (small to large screen sizes).
Verify bottom navigation menu is visible, functional, and visually consistent.
Navigate through all major screens using bottom menu.
Check that menus collapse/expand appropriately and no UI element is clipped or overlapped.
